title: AccessKey
description: An access key (ENT-21): the login credential whose scope is the V1 key-scoped access model (RULE-3 / PERM-1 / ADR-6). The on-disk key.json projection of the replicated `key:<uuid>` CRDT value, owned by a principal. Mirrored by zetta::AccessKey in include/zetta/access_key.hpp and zetta::Scope in include/zetta/scope.hpp; enforced by scope_from_json() in src/core/scope.cpp and Principal::load() in src/core/principal.cpp — keep them in sync. A malformed scope is rejected at the boundary so access never silently widens or narrows.

id.description: The key's UUID — its CRDT key and on-disk folder name. Present in key.json (where the folder name is the source of truth) and omitted from the CRDT value (the key carries it).

principal.description: The id of the Principal this key authenticates as.

created.description: ISO-8601 UTC creation stamp (millisecond precision, trailing 'Z').

scope.description: What the key permits — deny-by-default. A resource is in scope iff `unrestricted` is true or it appears in `grants`.

unrestricted.description: The '*' grant: when true the key reaches every resource (an admin key) and `grants` need not enumerate them.

grants.description: The explicit in-scope resources. Order is preserved.

resource.description: A single node-owned resource a grant names. V1 scopes to coarse, top-level resources (databases, projects); finer tiers extend the kind enum.
